titulo: Goodbye from the couch, then out the door
caption:
Goodbye from the couch, then out the door

My uncle says goodbye from the couch and walks out without turning. Then I stopped waiting at the door.

People tend to remember how an encounter ended more than how the middle went, so the last few seconds of a visit do a lot of the work.

For whoever turns around at the door to say goodbye.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one near the middle and a royal blue one on the left. The black one pulses and a bubble says bye!, the blue one answers bye! with happy eyes. Then the black one walks to the door, which opens, and walks out of the frame while the blue one watches. The door closes and the blue one pulses. The text stays: me saying bye then walking out. The last card: Choose friction.
